question: A, B, and C together can complete a task in 10 days. A alone takes 20 days, and B alone takes 30 days. How long will C alone take?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Take total work = LCM of 10, 20, 30 = 60 units

A+B+C = 60/10 = 6 units/day

A = 60/20 = 3, B = 60/30 = 2 units/day

C = 6 − (3+2) = 1 unit/day

Time for C = 60/1 = 60 days

**∴ The correct answer is 60 days.**
